identity_ownership_footprint.value: 576 restaurants at FY2025 year-end: 132 company-operated, 444 franchised. Fiscal 2025 systemwide sales of $918.8 million.
identity_ownership_footprint.strategic_implication: A majority-franchised estate means technology decisions likely require brand-standard mandates to reach most units.

identity_ownership_footprint.value: Executing an 18-month post-acquisition turnaround, 'Project Sunrise,' centered on food quality, operational simplification, value, guest trust, menu innovation, catering expansion, and loyalty.
identity_ownership_footprint.strategic_implication: Turnaround programs create real modernization pressure but also budget scrutiny; any pitch should tie directly to Project Sunrise's own stated outcomes.

account_economics_scale.value: Fiscal 2025: system same-store sales declined 3.7%, company-store transactions declined 6.9%, and restaurant-level margin was 11.1%. 14 restaurants opened, 32 closed.
account_economics_scale.strategic_implication: The inherited operating baseline was pressured, which is the explicit driver behind Project Sunrise and a credible reason for a modernization conversation.

relationship_history.value: Del Taco previously evaluated Genius for digital menu boards under Jack in the Box ownership; the effort went quiet around the divestiture when the desired system-on-chip approach did not align cleanly with the Genius solution at the time.
relationship_history.strategic_implication: There is real prior-cycle context and relationship history to draw on, but it is retrospective and must be revalidated under current Yadav leadership, not presented as still-active interest.

risks_and_cautions: Post-acquisition authority is still being established; Jack in the Box-era contracts and stakeholder assumptions may no longer apply under Yadav.
Qu announced a broad platform modernization in 2024, but deployment status, store coverage, contractual commitments, and Yadav's intent remain unconfirmed.
Del Taco is separately reported to be evaluating Nova as a new POS; Worldpay does not yet have a Nova card-present integration for enterprise merchants.
Several internally reported stakeholder names, titles, and authority levels remain unverified and require confirmation before external use.
Nick Hulayew's belief that Anil Yadav is a silent investor in Qu is unconfirmed competitive intelligence and must not be presented externally as fact.
